summary: To run a module's real main(), import the module, monkeypatch exit_json, set args, and call main().
questions: How do I run a module's main function from pytest?
How do I monkeypatch exit_json with pytest?

answer_card.title: Run a module's main() in pytest
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
import ansible.modules.module.group.my_module as my_module

def test_main_function(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(my_module.AnsibleModule, "exit_json", fake_exit_json)
    set_module_args({'activationkey': 'key', 'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
    my_module.main()
```
